senses.gloss:
mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
Prosperous, thriving, rising, &c.
n. (-द्धं)
1 Stored grain.
2 A demonstrated conclusion, a distinct result.
E.
ऋध to grow, &c. affix क्त.

f. (-द्धिः)
1 A medicinal plant; also सिद्धि.
2 Increase, growth.
3 Fortune, prosperity.
4 A name of the goddess PĀRVATĪ.
E.
ऋध to grow, &c. क्तिन् aff.

mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्)
Rich, prosperous.
E.
ऋद्भि and मतुप् aff.
